fact: The CREWS Action presentation note describes a USD 250,000 pilot, May to October 2025, to deploy and test MET Norway's Bris AI weather prediction system in the forecasting workflow of Malawi's Department of Climate Change and Meteorological Services.
Nation Online reports the Ministry of Agriculture, Water and Irrigation has piloted the Malawi Digital Plant Health Services project since 2022, built around the AI-powered PlantVillage app.

Nation Online reports lead farmers have used the AI PlantVillage app since 2023 to photograph crops and get written pest advisories, with data monitored by government experts through an AI observatory at the Department of Agriculture Extension Services and the Dedza district office.

The Malawi Revenue Authority's Kalondola digital excise tax stamp platform is supported by analytics and artificial intelligence to detect anomalies and flag risks, as reported by Nation Online on 22 July 2026.
